aomNorse.name: Norse
aomNorse.description:
{Norse}
Alignment: Neutral, Chaotic
Native terrain: Snow
Location: the northern fjords of Enroth
The Norse live in longhouse villages between the ice fields and the fjords, and worship four high gods: Odin, Thor, Loki and Freyr. Their berserkers and axemen fight together as warbands; trolls, winter wolves and giants roam the mountains, and valkyries descend from Valhalla to carry fallen warriors back to the gods. Every village awaits Ragnarok, when the Einherjar will rise again for the last battle.

special1.name: Temple of the Gods
special1.description:
The Temple of the Gods blesses each visiting hero once, according to the god they serve:
Thor's heroes Attack +1, Odin's Knowledge +1, Loki's Spell Power +1, Freyr's Defense +1, all other heroes Defense +1.

rewards.message: You make an offering before Thor's statue, and the god of thunder grants you strength. (+1 Attack)
You make an offering before Odin's statue, and the All-Father grants you wisdom. (+1 Knowledge)
You make an offering before Loki's statue, and the god of trickery grants you power. (+1 Spell Power)
You make an offering before Freyr's statue, and the god of plenty grants you protection. (+1 Defense)
The gods of the north do not know you, but the temple's wooden walls put you at ease. (+1 Defense)

special2.name: Gjallarhorn
special2.description:
Heimdall's horn increases the town's scouting radius by 15.
In sieges the garrison gets Morale +1, and Norse heroes start the battle with half a step of souls stored.

horde2.name: Valhalla
horde2.description:
In sieges, Norse heroes need only half the souls to recall Einherjar.
The first hero to visit each week gains 500 experience.

configuration.onVisitedMessage: The fallen have already told their battles to another hero this week.

rewards.message: The fallen gather round the long table and tell of their last battle; you learn much from them. (+500 experience)

horde2Upgr.name: Jotun Altar
horde2Upgr.description: An altar for giants' hearts. A hero carrying a giant's heart into town offers it automatically, and the kingdom gains a permanent upgrade: Mountain Giant Heart - level 1-4 dwellings in Norse towns +1 growth; Rock Giant Heart - troops defending a Norse town with a Fort get Defense +2; Frost Giant Heart - Norse troops take 25% less water spell damage, Norse heroes' water spells +10%; Fire Giant Heart - Norse troops Attack +1, Norse heroes' fire spells +10%. Once all four are offered, level 5-7 dwellings in Norse towns get +1 growth more.

rewards.message: You lay the Mountain Giant Heart on the Jotun Altar. One by one its runes light up, and the giant's strength flows into your kingdom: level 1-4 dwellings in Norse towns +1 weekly growth.
You lay the Rock Giant Heart on the Jotun Altar. One by one its runes light up, and the giant's strength flows into your kingdom: troops defending a Norse town (with a Fort) get Defense +2.

You lay the Frost Giant Heart on the Jotun Altar. One by one its runes light up, and the giant's strength flows into your kingdom: Norse troops take 25% less water spell damage, and Norse heroes' water spells deal +10% damage.

You lay the Fire Giant Heart on the Jotun Altar. One by one its runes light up, and the giant's strength flows into your kingdom: Norse troops Attack +1, and Norse heroes' fire spells deal +10% damage.

horde2Upgr2.name: Dwarven Armory
horde2Upgr2.description: The Dwarven Armory builds 2 Battering Rams each week, at 900 gold each, for visiting heroes to buy.

configuration.onSelectMessage: The dwarven smiths have built 2 Battering Rams this week, at 900 gold each. How many will you buy?
configuration.onVisitedMessage: This week's rams are sold out. Come back next week.
configuration.onEmptyMessage: You lack the gold, or there is no free slot in your army.

rewards.message: The dwarven smiths hand you 1 Battering Ram.
The dwarven smiths hand you 2 Battering Rams.

grail.name: Yggdrasil
grail.description:
Yggdrasil increases the town's income by 5000 gold per day and creature growth by 50%.
Roots of the Nine Worlds: when any of your Norse heroes enters battle, the Big Dipper lights 2 more stars, and souls +25%.
A hero of a Norse class who visits this town learns {Gate of the Nine Worlds}: once cast in battle, the Mountain, Rock, Frost and Fire Giants descend to your side one after another over four rounds.

rewards.message: A gate glows among the roots of Yggdrasil, and beyond it lie the nine worlds. You commit the runes on the gate to memory, and can now open it on the battlefield. (Learned Gate of the Nine Worlds)
The shadow of a gate lies among the roots of Yggdrasil, but you cannot read the runes on it. Only a Norse hero can open it.

extraCapitol.name: Archaic Age
extraCapitol.description:
A Norse town starts in the Archaic Age. When every building of an age is built, the town moves on to the next age automatically.
The next age is the {Classical Age}: needs Tavern, Fort, Marketplace, Berserker Lodge and Axe Range.

special3.name: Classical Age
special3.description:
Reached automatically when all of this age's buildings are built.
Level 1-2 creature growth +2 per week.
The next age is the {Heroic Age}: needs Town Hall, Mage Guild Level 2, Citadel, Blacksmith, Troll Cave and Wolf Den.

rewards.message:
This town has entered the {Classical Age}.

Level 1-2 creature growth +2 per week.

special4.name: Heroic Age
special4.description:
Reached automatically when all of this age's buildings are built.
Level 1-2 creature growth +3 per week, level 3-4 +1.
Your troops gain +20% stack experience (counted once however many towns).
The next age is the {Mythic Age}: needs City Hall, Mage Guild Level 3, Castle, Temple of the Gods, Valkyrie Hall, and Kraken Fjord or Fafnir Hoard.

rewards.message:
This town has entered the {Heroic Age}.

Level 1-2 creature growth +3 per week, level 3-4 +1.
Your troops gain +20% stack experience (counted once however many towns).

extraTownHall.name: Mythic Age
extraTownHall.description:
Reached automatically when all of this age's buildings are built.
Level 1-2 creature growth +3 per week, level 3-4 +2.
Your troops gain +20% stack experience (counted once however many towns).
In sieges, Norse heroes gain +10% souls.
The next age is the {Wonder Age}: needs Capitol, Mage Guild Level 5, Gjallarhorn, Resource Silo and Ginnungagap Gate.

rewards.message:
This town has entered the {Mythic Age}.

Level 1-2 creature growth +3 per week, level 3-4 +2.
Your troops gain +20% stack experience (counted once however many towns).
In sieges, Norse heroes gain +10% souls.
